## Summary / 摘要

Describe the change and why it is needed.
请说明改动内容与必要性。

## Type / 类型

- [ ] Feature / 新功能
- [ ] Bug fix / 缺陷修复
- [ ] Documentation / 文档
- [ ] Tests / 测试
- [ ] Chore / dependency / 杂项或依赖

## Checklist / 检查清单

- [ ] `Rscript tests/testthat.R` passes. / 通过。
- [ ] `Rscript dev/coverage.R` reports service coverage ≥ 80%. / service 覆盖率 ≥ 80%。
- [ ] `Rscript tests/shinytest2/run-tests.R` passes. / 通过。
- [ ] `Rscript dev/i18n_check.R` passes. / 通过。
- [ ] `Rscript dev/docs_check.R` passes. / 通过。
- [ ] `Rscript dev/check_release.R` passes. / 通过。
- [ ] New or changed UI strings have `en` and `zh` translations. /
      新增或修改的界面文案均有中英文。
- [ ] `www/js/i18n.js` was regenerated with `dev/build_i18n.R`. /
      已用 `dev/build_i18n.R` 重新生成。
- [ ] English and Chinese documentation pairs were updated together. /
      中英文档成对更新。
- [ ] Screenshots (EN/ZH × light/dark) are attached for UI changes. /
      界面改动附中英文 × 亮暗截图。
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or confidential data are included. /
      不包含密钥、令牌或机密数据。
- [ ] Licence and attribution statements remain accurate. /
      许可与署名声明仍然准确。

## i18n keys / i18n key

List added or modified keys.
列出新增或修改的 key。

## Screenshots / 截图

Attach or link EN/ZH and light/dark screenshots.
附上或链接中英文、亮暗截图。

## Notes for reviewers / 审阅说明

Anything that needs special attention.
需要特别关注的内容。
